title: Staff read a bench run's rounds and turns with durations, tokens and tools, never their text
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: A planner run's rounds and turns come back with durations, tokens and tool names and no text.
An unknown bench, a malformed id and a missing run are refused.

tests: a planner run's rounds and turns: durations, tokens, tool names, never the text
